parameters.name: needsReview
parameters.description: Only pending dApps and approved dApps with a pending change. Unless `orderBy` is given, they are sorted by how long they have waited for review, oldest first with `order=asc`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the name, owner email, contact email or Auth0 client id.

auth0ClientId.description: Null until the dApp is provisioned.

version.description: Send it back as `expectedVersion` with the next change.

name.description: 1–64 UTF-16 code units once trimmed (most emoji count as two or more), no `<` or `>`.

description.description: At most 140 UTF-16 code units once trimmed; may be empty.

logoUrl.description: An `https:` URL of at most 255 characters.

reviewedBy.description: Null until an admin reviews it. Stays null after auto-approval.

auth0Error.description: The last Auth0 error, cleared by the next successful Auth0 write.

total.description: Every dApp that matches the filters.

reason.description: 10–2000 UTF-16 code units once trimmed (most emoji count as two or more).

field.description: The contact email changed. Its values are not logged.

payload.description: The synced fields sent to Auth0.
